plan: This is a second-price auction (highest bidder pays second-highest bid). In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others bid. Bidding my value ensures I win whenever profitable (when my value exceeds the second-highest bid) and never pay more than my value. There's no benefit to shading my bid up or down since payment is determined by the second-highest bid, not my own bid.

This is a second-price sealed-bid auction where I pay the second-highest bid if I win. In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, since I only pay what the second-highest bidder bid, not my own bid. Bidding my true value ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the others' bids (maximizing profit) and never overpay. There's no benefit to shading my bid up or down.

This is a second-price auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid. In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, since I only pay the second-highest bid if I win, not my own bid. Bidding my true value of $42 ensures I win whenever profitable (when my value exceeds others' bids) and never overpay, since I only pay the second-highest bid regardless of what I bid above that. This maximizes expected profit.
